entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 3,650 K (Inglis et al. 2024, Table 1), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white.

entries.subject: A Gaia BP/RP spectrum of this star as the colour
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 has no BP/RP spectrum that describes this star alone, so the paper temperature gives the colour.
entries.revisitWhen: Gaia publishes a spectrum of this star alone.

entries.subject: Limb darkening of the sphere
entries.finding: No fit of this star's limb exists, so the sphere is darkened by the quadratic Johnson V law Claret and Bloemen (2011) compute from ATLAS model atmospheres at 3,650 K and log g 4.03, from the record's mass and radius: a model. It replaced the uniform disc of the first version.

entries.subject: The two stars' radii in Inglis et al. (2024)
entries.finding: Table 1 gives 1.51 +/- 0.02 solar radii for A and 1.39 +/- 0.02 for B; the text of section 6 gives 1.42 +/- 0.01 and 1.59 +/- 0.02. The table is used; the difference is recorded, not resolved.
